statement: Raw triggers/stick/pad/IMU fields are s16 LE and pressure u16 LE at offsets mapped by input-42/input-45; SDL maps trigger raw to int(raw)*2-32768, left/right stick Y inverted for SDL, pad X normalized raw/65536+0.5 and Y normalized -raw/65536+0.5, pressure raw/32768, accelerometer raw/32768*2*g, and gyro raw/32768*2000deg/s converted to radians/s with axis reordering (X,Z,-Y). 0x42/0x45 u32 IMU tick is treated as microseconds by SDL, 0x47 u16 tick is 32us. Report units derive from SDL consumer code, not a device calibration. SDL driver:222-233,246-348; Linux:2325-2354,2431-2496.

applicability.revision: host consumers at Linux v7.3-rc1 and SDL 6defbc0; physical revision not measured
applicability.scope: Wired USB 28de:1302; host-side source parsing / host commands only, no live or physical validation. Refer to docs/steam-controller-2026-research-gaps.md C6 section.
